subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should CodexBar adopt Scope B’s exact-normalized-name aggregation and explicitly non-deduplicated source totals as a supported Usage & Spend contract?
rationale: The central discussion identifies canonical identity and double counting as unresolved product semantics, while this branch chooses one behavior that can change how users interpret totals.

options.title: Defer Scope B pending a data contract
options.body: Keep the feature discussion open until maintainers define canonical identity and duplicate-source treatment, then request a narrowed implementation.

options.title: Approve the conservative exact-name contract
options.body: Accept exact normalized-name grouping and non-deduplicated source totals, but require the Kimi-only rendering repair before merge.

recommendation.title: Defer Scope B pending a data contract
recommendation.body: Keep the feature discussion open until maintainers define canonical identity and duplicate-source treatment, then request a narrowed implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the strongest available routing candidate for a feature-scope and data-interpretation decision.
